mainEntity.name: Should we build our online store on Shopify or go fully custom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shopify suits most brands with standard catalogues, because hosting, security and core checkout are managed for you. A headless approach keeps Shopify's backend while giving you a faster, fully custom storefront. Fully custom ecommerce development makes sense for marketplaces, complex B2B pricing, unusual product configuration or deep ERP-driven workflows. We recommend the option after discovery, based on total cost of ownership rather than preference.

mainEntity.name: How much do ecommerce development services cost, and what affects price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on scope: the platform chosen, number of custom features, catalogue size, data migration complexity, and how many systems need integrating, such as ERP, CRM, payment gateways and shipping providers. Design depth and ongoing support also affect the budget. We provide a scoped estimate after discovery, so you know what is included before development starts.

mainEntity.name: How do you migrate an existing store without losing data or rankings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Migration is planned to protect both. Products, customers and order history are mapped and test-migrated before launch, and every old URL receives a redirect to its new equivalent to preserve search visibility. Integrations are tested in parallel with the live store, and cutover is scheduled for a low-traffic window, with monitoring in place to catch issues quickly after launch.
